question: The value of ((0.66)³ - (0.22)³)/((0.66)² + 0.1452 + (0.22)²) is:
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Recognize identity: (a³ − b³) ÷ (a² + ab + b²) = a − b Here 0.1452 = 0.66 × 0.22 ⇒ denominator = a² + ab + b² So expression = a − b = 0.66 − 0.22 = 0.44 **∴ Answer = 0.44**
